title: Breakfast at home

turns.speaker: father
turns.text: おはよう。朝ご飯はパンにしますか。ご飯もありますよ。
turns.translation: Good morning. Will you have bread for breakfast? We have rice too.

turns.speaker: daughter
turns.text: パンがいいです。卵も食べたいです。
turns.translation: I'd like bread. I'd like an egg too.

turns.speaker: father
turns.text: ごめん、卵はありません。バナナはあります。
turns.translation: Sorry, we don't have any eggs. We have bananas.

turns.speaker: daughter
turns.text: じゃ、パンとバナナにします。お父さんは何を食べますか。
turns.translation: Then I'll have bread and a banana. What will you have, Dad?

turns.speaker: father
turns.text: 私はご飯です。バナナはいくついりますか。
turns.translation: I'll have rice. How many bananas would you like?

turns.speaker: daughter
turns.text: 二つください。一つは今食べて、一つは学校で食べます。
turns.translation: Two, please. I'll eat one now and one at school.
